name: Hengyuan Refining Company Berhad
overview: 2026年，Hengyuan Refining Company Berhad 的业务仍以石油精炼与销售为主，公告中未披露产能扩张、新业务或资产出售等业务层面变动。公司宣派2026财年每股10.00仙的中期股息，并寻求股东批准续期关联方经常性交易授权及新增授权。
overview_en: In 2026, Hengyuan Refining Company Berhad's business remained focused on petroleum refining and sales, with no announcements disclosing capacity expansion, new businesses, or asset disposals at the business level. The company declared an interim dividend of 10.00 sen per share for FY2026 and sought shareholder approval to renew the mandate for recurrent related party transactions and a new mandate.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司层面涉及股息宣派及股东授权事项。
segments.note_en: Company-level matters involve dividend declaration and shareholder mandate matters.

actions.title: HENGYUAN - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派2026财年每股10.00仙的中期股息，除息日为2026年9月14日，派发日为2026年9月28日。
actions.text_en: Declared an interim dividend of 10.00 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 14 September 2026 and payment date on 28 September 2026.
